LETTER OF DEFICIENCY (DRAFT)
File No.: AICTE/RB/NO/2027-28/APP-04
Date: 2026-10-27
Institute: Stonebridge Technical Campus
Permanent Id: 1-7832499
Application: APP-04 (2027-28)

The following deficiencies were found in the application for Extension of Approval:
1. Structural Stability Certificate out of validity (Structural Stability Certificate)
   The Structural Stability Certificate is more than 5 years old (or past the validity written on it). Issued 2022-10-27, allowed 3 years, so valid until 2025-10-27.
   Handbook: "6.17 h. - Structural Stability Certificate is valid for a period of FIVE years from the date of issue."
   To submit: Upload a Structural Stability Certificate that is valid on the date of submission.

Draft prepared by Pramaan (advisory). To be reviewed and signed by the competent officer.
